The film’s worldwide gross has reached Rs. 528.77 crore. As Day 17 live tracking continues, the next major domestic target is the Rs. 350 crore India net mark.

He whimsically suggested that this money could be enjoyed in France instead of domestically, referencing current protests in France over financial strains and public services. The intention behind this proposal is to encourage spending within the US economy.

description: In October, foreign investors pulled out Rs 52,100 crore from Indian equity markets, contributing to overall outflows this year. Escalating crude oil prices and elevated US bond yields have swayed this selling behavior. Although there was a momentary resurgence in buying, the cautious investor sentiment prevails against a backdrop of global economic volatility.

title: ‘Chalo Yamuna Abhiyan’: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta joins cleanliness drive at ITO
description: In an effort to restore the Yamuna River's beauty, Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta took part in a cleanliness drive alongside her Cabinet colleagues and enthusiastic youth volunteers from local social groups. Together, they worked diligently to rid the riverbank of plastic and idol fragments, stressing the communal responsibility for the river's upkeep.

title: Gill falls for 1 run: India Test captain fails on Ranji return ahead of NZ Tests
description: Shubman Gill scored just one run for Punjab against Chhattisgarh in his Ranji Trophy return ahead of India’s Test series against New Zealand, starting November 19. Ajay Mandal dismissed him after five deliveries. Gill will play the first three New Zealand ODIs before preparing for the Tests. Despite the setback, he has scored 1,095 international runs this year, including four centuries.

The police have arrested the driver and the truck owner, raising questions from families over the vehicle's entry into a restricted zone.

title: Can hackers get into your fridge? Your smart home may be less safe than you think
description: As the prevalence of internet-connected devices grows, so do the vulnerabilities they present to consumers. Everyday items like refrigerators, surveillance cameras, and smart cars are at risk of cyber intrusion. Hackers can exploit these devices to steal personal data and disrupt vital services. Experts suggest measures such as changing default passwords, enabling two-factor authentication, and minimizing the number of online devices to mitigate these threats.

title: ‘RR are at the top of the list’: Ashwin makes big revelation on Hardik Pandya trade
description: With the IPL season looming, the chatter about Hardik Pandya's future at Mumbai Indians is heating up. Renowned former cricketer Ravichandran Ashwin suggested that a move to Chennai Super Kings could be advantageous for CSK, though he doubts its likelihood anytime soon. Ashwin sees Rajasthan Royals as a more realistic contender for Hardik's next signing. Additionally, Mumbai Indians face a critical juncture after losing head coach Mahela Jayawardene.

Sahu's unsupported claims of illegal assets compel the formation of a Special Investigation Team. Arya highlights the vital role of women in speaking against domestic abuse, promoting empowerment and transparency amidst the tumult.

title: New Jersey court upholds will cutting two sons out of mother’s estate
description: A New Jersey mother who initially planned to divide her estate equally among her four children changed her will in 2016, excluding both sons after their relationship deteriorated. Following her death in 2024, the sons challenged the decision, alleging that their sisters had influenced her. One daughter had been her sole caregiver since 1996. However, on October 16, 2026, a New Jersey appeals court upheld the revised will.

title: Google cofounder Sergey Brin donated $100 mn but cannot cast a vote next month
description: Sergey Brin has made a significant contribution against California's proposed billionaire wealth tax to avoid financial impacts. After relocating to Nevada, he is no longer eligible to vote on this measure. This one-time tax is set to apply only to California residents from 2026 if approved. Other tech billionaires like Eric Schmidt and Peter Thiel have joined Brin in opposing the tax.

title: Astronomers discover green star 280 light-years away; what makes it glow green
description: Astronomers have discovered an intriguing white dwarf star designated WD J1330+6435, nestled within the Draco constellation. Its striking green hue arises from the interaction of sodium and helium particles in its atmosphere. This celestial body lies about 280 light-years from Earth, presenting itself as it was 280 years ago. With a surface temperature nearing 4,000 degrees Celsius, its dimensions are comparable to that of our planet.

title: ‘Pandal will collapse’: Announcement that may have triggered Kolkata stampede; watch
description: A stampede occurred at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal, leading to 19 fatalities and multiple injuries. Panic ensued after a warning announced the potential collapse of the pandal, contributing to the chaos. Police investigations revealed issues with crowd management and inadequate announcements during the event. The government has promised compensation for the victims' families and is reviewing safety protocols at puja pandals.

title: ‘Massive difference between words and actions’: Ex-cricketer’s on Jadeja’s snub
description: Aakash Chopra is voicing his concerns about the absence of Ravindra Jadeja from India's ODI series against New Zealand, suggesting a preference for Axar Patel that contradicts previous commitments made by management regarding Jadeja's future. Additionally, the exclusion of Manav Suthar from the Test squad is puzzling, considering his stellar debut. Chopra advocates for selectors to openly discuss the reasons behind such omissions with players to foster transparency.

title: School woes, inflation, political discontent: What is fuelling violent France protests

description: A cowshed project in Dabhoura, Rewa district, has been marred by alleged fraud and incomplete work. Despite receiving over Rs 20 lakh, the project features only a partially built boundary wall. Investigators revealed that the tender process was allegedly manipulated to benefit a specific supplier, resulting in legal action against six individuals. The Economic Offences Wing is actively investigating the irregularities surrounding the project's funding and execution.

title: How Indian couples are spending crores to have a baby boy
description: Affluent Indian couples are increasingly opting for foreign IVF and surrogacy packages to ensure the birth of male children. Destinations such as the UAE, US, and Colombia offer advanced gender selection technologies, a practice not permitted in India. With costs ranging from ₹15 lakh to ₹1.7 crore, this trend prompts many to seek services abroad, particularly as regulatory changes within India prompt couples to explore international options.

title: How Tom Brady's childhood love for baseball cards inspired his business
description: Tom Brady's love for baseball cards began in his youth and has only deepened over the years. His treasured collection of Don Mattingly cards symbolizes his lifelong enthusiasm. Now, as a co-owner of CardVault, he is dedicated to enhancing the store's impact in the trading card world. Brady aims to enrich inventory and elevate customer experiences, striving to motivate a fresh wave of collectors through his entrepreneurial ventures.

title: Travis Kelce's $5.35m mansion faces another property review
description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion faces fresh scrutiny as local officials continue reviewing plans for the historic lakeside estate. While the revised six-foot privacy fence received approval in September, the proposed rear landscaping remains unresolved. Neighbors have raised concerns about tree heights and potential damage to shared sewer lines. Bratenahl’s Architectural Review Board is scheduled to revisit the landscaping proposal on November 10, 2026, leaving parts of the property improvements pending.

title: Internet is fundamental right of all, even children: Supreme Court

The encounter turned violent when the reportedly intoxicated driver attacked her, leading to bystanders stepping in. Authorities arrested him, filing charges under multiple laws. Medical reports verified the family's injuries, and an investigation into the drunk driving claims is actively progressing.

The judge concluded that the prosecution was unable to substantiate its claims against the accused. Abid, who was assaulted by armed attackers while supporting his father near the Old Bus Stand, ultimately succumbed to his wounds despite nearby shopowners' attempts to assist.

Following their first store's success in 2020, which garnered over 3,100 dedicated volunteers, the couple has invested $1 million into this new initiative to ensure families receive dignified access to food choices and additional resources.
